title: Completed-coefficient pushforward restriction and strict reduction towers
statement:
Fix distinct primes $p,\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $A=\mathcal O_E$ and uniformizer $t$, and put $A_n=A/(t^n)$ for $n\geq1$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $f:X\to Y$ be any morphism of schemes, using the small pro-etale sites with their small-skeleton convention [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. For $W=X,Y$ set $R_W=\varprojlim_n(A_n)_W$, the completed coefficient sheaf [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients], and let $\underline A_W$ denote the constant sheaf [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. Use the structural maps $f^{-1}R_Y\to R_X$ induced by the finite projections, and the canonical identifications $f^{-1}\underline A_Y=\underline A_X$ and $f^{-1}(A_n)_Y=(A_n)_X$ [def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback]. Let $D(B)$ be the ordinary unbounded derived category of sheaves of modules over the ring sheaf $B$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Write $U_W:D(R_W)\to D(\underline A_W)$ and $V_{W,n}:D((A_n)_W)\to D(R_W)$ for termwise restriction of scalars [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars]. Denote the K-injective total derived direct images for these ringed topoi by $F_R=Rf_{*,R}$, $F_A=Rf_{*,\underline A}$ and $F_n=Rf_{*,A_n}$ [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-pushforward-composition].

There are canonical natural isomorphisms
$$U_YF_R\xrightarrow{\sim}F_AU_X,\qquad F_RV_{X,n}\xrightarrow{\sim}V_{Y,n}F_n.$$
Their normalization compares the two factorizations of the same composite morphism of ringed topoi, using the K-injective derived-composition comparisons of [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-pushforward-composition]. For $m\geq n$, the latter comparisons commute with coefficient restriction along $A_m\to A_n$, with the coherence for successive restrictions and quotient maps. For a strict complex of coefficient systems $(M_n)_n$, with $M_n$ an $(A_n)_X$-module complex and transition maps linear through $A_{n+1}\to A_n$, this compatibility is a comparison of derived strict-diagram functors after restriction to $R_X$-module towers, not only an equality of evaluated arrows. Here strict towers and their derived inverse limits are interpreted by [lem-weil-ringed-tower-pushforward-limit-comparison].

If $K\in D(R_X)$ is derived $t$-complete [def-weil-derived-complete], form its strict reduction system $K_n=K\otimes^L_{R_X}(A_n)_X$ on one flat-term K-flat representative, with the quotient transitions [def-weil-integral-reduction-tower]. Then $F_RK$ is derived $t$-complete and the preceding comparisons give a canonical natural isomorphism
$$F_RK\xrightarrow{\sim}R\varprojlim_n V_{Y,n}F_nK_n.$$
The right side is obtained by applying total derived direct image to the strict restricted reduction tower and then total derived inverse limit. Under this comparison its $n$-th projection is $F_R$ of $K\to V_{X,n}K_n$, followed by the displayed coefficient-restriction comparison. Finally $U_YF_RK\cong F_AU_XK$ identifies the direct image on complete $R$-modules with the direct image on complete constant-$A$ modules under the equivalences of [lem-weil-pbc-constant-completion-equivalence].
